# Orvio 0.51

- TV guide: a full programme grid with channels down and time across, from a day back to a day ahead. On TV, open it with "▦ TV guide" in the left column, hold OK on a channel and choose "TV guide", or press the remote's GUIDE key. On phones, tap "▦ Guide" next to the channel search. It shows the same channels as your list.
- On TV, ◀ ▶ moves from programme to programme and ▲ ▼ changes channel. OK watches what is on now, replays a past programme on channels with catch-up (⟲), and shows details for programmes still to come. Hold OK for the channel options. Back returns to the channel list on the channel you were on.
- On phones, swipe through time, tap to watch, long-press for details, and tap "Now" to jump back to the current time.
